question: does the image null survive when frames are pooled PER PLANE instead of averaged across all planes?
motivation: the default representation averages twice: USFM pools patches within a frame, then the pipeline means ~22 frames of DIFFERENT anatomical planes per fetus. Any plane-specific or localised signal is destroyed before the statistics start. Per-plane blocks also have genuine WITHIN-block structure, unlike a PCA of the pooled vector.

plane_labels.choice: used IMPACT ground-truth `plane` (12,929 frames); plane_prop failed a visual audit on the clinical set

bh_survivors.cerebral_Doppler: +0.101, p=0.030, q=0.096 — the ONLY non-growth survivor
bh_survivors.note: growth is measurement recovery (biometry is measured from these images), so the only novel candidate was cerebral->Doppler

CEREBRAL_DOPPLER_DOES_NOT_LOCALISE.design: if cerebral images genuinely track cerebral haemodynamics, the signal must sit on MCA (Percentil_ACM) and CPR — the cerebral Doppler measurements — not on the placental ones
CEREBRAL_DOPPLER_DOES_NOT_LOCALISE.VERDICT: THE MECHANISM FAILS. Cerebral images track ACM at r=+0.013 (p=0.12) and CPR at r=+0.022 (p=0.10) — both essentially zero and neither clearing its null. The largest per-variable value is a NEGATIVE -0.107 against the umbilical artery, a PLACENTAL vessel that cerebral images do not depict. The block-level +0.101 is therefore not cerebral haemodynamics; it is a diffuse multivariate association with no anatomical localisation, which is what a residual confound looks like rather than a finding.

WHAT_PER_PLANE_DID_CHANGE.maternal_confound_confirmed_in_every_pla: cerebral 0.43->0.02, abdominal 0.34->0.06, femur 0.23->0.04 on BMI adjustment
WHAT_PER_PLANE_DID_CHANGE.cardiac_is_plane_dependent: cerebral -0.006 vs femur +0.122 — but neither survives BH (q=0.114, 0.535)
WHAT_PER_PLANE_DID_CHANGE.growth_unchanged: +0.117 to +0.167 across planes vs +0.159 pooled; measurement recovery is plane-general as expected

CONCLUSION: Per-plane pooling was the strongest remaining objection to today's image nulls, and it does NOT overturn them. It surfaces exactly one new candidate — cerebral->Doppler at q=0.096 — which dissolves on localisation: the signal is absent from the cerebral Doppler variables themselves and largest against a placental vessel. The image null now holds under a representation that preserves plane identity.
caveats: 4 PCs per plane vs 12 for pooled — per-plane blocks have less capacity; a like-for-like dimension match was not run
femur has only 1,215 labelled frames across 794 fetuses (~1.5 frames per fetus), so that block is close to single-frame and noisier than the others
still mean-pooled WITHIN plane; patch tokens remain untested and would need re-extraction
radiomics (raw-pixel texture, already extracted for all 21,192 IMPACT frames) is the remaining encoder-independent check and was not run here
